# Albert Womga — Freelance AI/ML Engineer & Data Scientist

> Albert Tchaptchet Womga is a data scientist and AI/ML engineer based in Ottawa, Canada, available for freelance projects in Canada, Cameroon and remotely. He works in English and French and builds machine-learning systems for production: LLM agents, MLOps pipelines, NLP, time-series forecasting and computer vision. He has 15+ years of delivery across government, healthcare and legal tech.

## Services

- [Machine Learning Solutions](https://albwt.com/services): custom end-to-end ML pipelines, from data preparation to model deployment.
- [LLM agents & AI automation](https://albwt.com/sandbox): production AI agents with caching, rate limits and deterministic fallbacks, running on serverless infrastructure.
- [Predictive Analytics & Forecasting](https://albwt.com/services): time-series models (ARIMA/SARIMA, LSTM, Transformers) for demand, energy, markets and operations.
- [NLP & Text Analytics](https://albwt.com/services): document classification (e.g. DistilBERT), extraction and analytics over text.
- [Computer Vision](https://albwt.com/services): CNN-based image classification, detection and behavioural analysis.
- [Data Analysis & Visualization](https://albwt.com/services): exploratory analysis, statistical modelling and dashboards for decision-makers.
- [AI Strategy Consulting](https://albwt.com/services): guidance for organizations adopting AI and data science at scale.

## Selected projects

- [GitHub Repo Analyzer agent (live demo)](https://albwt.com/sandbox): LangGraph.js agent on Supabase Edge Functions that fetches, analyzes and reports on any public GitHub repository.
- [Energy ARIMA Forecasting](https://github.com/womgaalbert/Energy-ARIMA-Forecasting): ARIMA/SARIMA forecasting of U.S. industrial energy production (1939–2025).
- [BFRB Sensor Fusion](https://github.com/womgaalbert/Detect-Behavior-with-Sensor-Data): multimodal time-series classification with LSTM/Transformer and sensor fusion.
- [Transformer Time Series Prediction](https://github.com/womgaalbert/transformer-time-series-prediction): attention-based forecasting.
- [ConvNet on CIFAR-10](https://github.com/womgaalbert/Convnet-On-CIFAR-10): CNN built from scratch.
- [Student Plurilingual Representation](https://github.com/womgaalbert/Student-Plurilingual-Representation-French-Learning): MLOps pipeline with XGBoost, SMOTE and MLflow.
- [cmavocate.ca](https://cmavocate.ca): legal aid web platform.
